name: qmhf-website
description: Queen Mary Hedge Fund Official Website

scripts.dev: npm run build:dev && npm run serve:dev
scripts.build:dev: npm run clean && npm run copy:assets && npm run build:css:dev && npm run build:js:dev
scripts.build:prod: npm run clean && npm run copy:assets && npm run build:css:prod && npm run build:js:prod && npm run minify:html
scripts.deploy:staging: npm run build:dev && npm run serve:dev
scripts.deploy:production: npm run build:prod && npm run serve:prod
scripts.copy:assets: mkdir -p dist && cp -r src/images dist/ 2>/dev/null || mkdir -p dist/images && cp -r src/videos dist/ 2>/dev/null || mkdir -p dist/videos
scripts.minify:css: cleancss -o dist/css/style.min.css src/css/style.css && cleancss -o dist/css/animations.min.css src/css/animations.css
scripts.build:github-pages: npm run clean && npm run copy:assets && npm run build:css:prod && npm run build:js:prod && npm run minify:html:github-pages
scripts.test: npm run lint:check && npm run validate:html:check
scripts.lint:check: eslint src/js/*.js || echo 'Linting issues found - run npm run lint to fix'
scripts.validate:html:check: html-validate src/**/*.html || echo 'HTML validation issues found'
scripts.watch: npm run build:dev && npm run serve:dev & chokidar 'src/**/*' -c 'npm run build:dev'

author: Queen Mary Hedge Fund
